Lifestyle Coaching

Tried every diet, only to slip back into old habits? Lifestyle coaching works on the everyday things that really drive your weight and health: sleep, movement, eating patterns, stress and routine. Your coach helps you make small, realistic changes that fit your life in Kerala, and stays with you until they become second nature.

5Pillars of health

1-to-1Support

Overview

What is Lifestyle Coaching?

Most weight and health problems aren't caused by one big mistake. They're the result of small daily habits: late nights, skipped breakfasts, long hours at a desk, evening snacks, stress that never switches off. Diets try to fix the food and ignore the rest, which is why the weight so often comes back.

Lifestyle coaching looks at the whole picture. Your coach gets to know your routine, work, family and food, finds the habits that are holding you back, and helps you change them one step at a time. There are no strict rules and no guilt, just practical changes that feel normal within a few weeks.

Read more: why habits beat willpower

Willpower runs out, especially after a long day. Habits don't need it. Once something becomes automatic, like a walk after dinner or a set bedtime, you do it without thinking.

That's why coaching focuses on a few small changes at a time, with regular check-ins to keep you on track. Small wins build confidence, and confidence builds the next habit.

1. UnderstandYour coach learns your routine, challenges and goals.
2. ChangeOne or two small, realistic habits at a time.
3. KeepRegular check-ins until the new habits feel natural.

Quick self-check

What's Your Lifestyle Score?

Six quick questions. Tap one answer each to see your score and the two habits to work on first.

  1. 1How many hours do you usually sleep?
  2. 2How active are you on most days?
  3. 3How often do you snack or eat late at night?
  4. 4How much water do you drink a day?
  5. 5How often do you feel stressed or overwhelmed?
  6. 6How much screen time do you have before bed?
Your lifestyle score Answer the questions

Tap one answer for each question to see your score and what to work on first.

Talk to a coach

The 5 pillars

What Your Coach Works On

Tap a pillar, then open the questions for practical tips you can start today.

Poor sleep raises the hormones that make you hungry and crave sweets, and lowers the one that tells you you're full. Two short nights can undo a week of careful eating.

How much sleep do I need?
Most adults need 7 to 8 hours. The time you go to bed matters as much as the hours: going to sleep before 11 pm helps your body clock.
Simple ways to sleep better
Keep the same bedtime, even on weekends. Dim the lights an hour before bed, keep the room cool and dark, and leave your phone outside the bedroom if you can.
Shift work or a newborn?
We plan around real life. If your sleep is broken, we focus on protecting your longest block of sleep and adding short naps.

You don't need a gym membership to start. Daily movement matters more than occasional hard workouts.

Where do I start?
Start with a 10-minute walk after meals. It helps blood sugar and digestion, and it's easy to keep up.
How much is enough?
Aim for about 7,000 to 10,000 steps a day, plus 2 or 3 short strength sessions a week to protect your muscle.
I have a desk job
Stand or walk for 2 to 3 minutes every hour, take calls on your feet and use the stairs. Small moves add up.

It's not just what you eat, but when, how fast and why. We work on habits, not strict diets you'll quit in a month.

Do I have to give up rice?
No. We adjust portions and pair rice with more vegetables, dal, fish, egg or chicken, so the meal keeps you full for longer.
Snacking and late-night eating
Late-night snacking is often down to tiredness, boredom or skipped meals. Regular meals and a planned evening snack usually fix it.
Eating out and family functions
We plan for weddings, festivals and office lunches, so you can enjoy them without losing your progress.

Long-term stress raises cortisol, which drives belly fat, cravings and poor sleep. Managing stress is part of managing weight.

Quick ways to calm down
Slow breathing for 2 minutes, a short walk outdoors or a few stretches between tasks can lower stress quickly.
Emotional eating
We help you notice the triggers, like stress, boredom or loneliness, and build other ways to cope.
Making time for yourself
Even 15 minutes a day for something you enjoy makes a difference. We help you find it in a busy week.

Good habits stick when they're built into your day. We design a routine that fits your work, family and commute.

Start small
Change one or two things at a time. Once they feel automatic, we add the next.
Plan ahead
Plan meals for the week, keep healthy snacks ready and lay out walking shoes the night before.
Track the right things
Track habits like sleep, steps and water, not just weight. Habits drive results.

Signs you need it

Does This Sound Like You?

"I lose weight, then put it back on."
Yo-yo dieting is a sign the habits underneath haven't changed. Coaching fixes the habits, so the results last.
"I'm tired all the time."
Poor sleep, long gaps between meals and too little movement are common causes. Small changes can lift your energy within weeks.
"I eat well, but snack at night."
Usually a sign of skipped meals, tiredness or stress. We fix the day so the evenings get easier.
"I know what to do, I just don't do it."
You're not lazy. You need a plan that fits real life and someone to keep you accountable.
"My doctor said I need to change my lifestyle."
For PCOS, prediabetes, high blood pressure or fatty liver, coaching turns that advice into a clear, doable plan.

A healthy day

What a Healthy Day Can Look Like

A simple, Kerala-friendly example. Your coach adjusts it to your work, family and food.

  1. 6:30 am

    Wake up and hydrate

    A glass of water and 5 minutes of sunlight or stretching to wake your body up.

  2. 8:00 am

    Protein breakfast

    Puttu with kadala, egg with dosa or oats with nuts, so you stay full until lunch.

  3. 1:00 pm

    Balanced lunch

    Half the plate vegetables, a fist of rice, plus fish, chicken, egg or dal. Then a 10-minute walk.

  4. 5:00 pm

    Smart snack

    Fruit, sprouts or roasted chana instead of fried snacks and sweet tea.

  5. 8:00 pm

    Light, early dinner

    Eat 2 to 3 hours before bed, with more vegetables and protein, and less rice.

  6. 10:30 pm

    Wind down

    Screens off, lights low, and in bed for 7 to 8 hours of sleep.

Find your plan

What's Your Biggest Challenge?

Answer two quick questions to see how your coach would start.

1What gets in your way most?

2What's your work schedule like?

What to expect

Benefits of Lifestyle Coaching

Changes you feel in your energy, sleep and body, that last long after the programme.

Lasting Weight Loss

Habits you can keep, so the weight stays off.

Better Sleep

Fall asleep easier and wake up feeling rested.

More Energy

Steady energy through the day without the afternoon slump.

Healthier Numbers

Helps blood sugar, blood pressure and cholesterol.

Less Stress

Practical tools to handle stress and emotional eating.

No Crash Diets

Real food, Kerala-friendly meals and no starving.

Plan That Fits You

Built around your job, family and schedule.

Someone in Your Corner

Regular check-ins keep you motivated and on track.

Swipe to see more

How it works

Your Lifestyle Coaching Journey

We start by understanding your life.

  • A detailed chat about your routine, work, sleep, food and stress.
  • A body composition analysis to see your fat, muscle and visceral fat.
  • A look at any health conditions or blood test results.
  • Clear, realistic goals that matter to you.

A plan built around your real day.

  • One or two habits to start with, not a long list of rules.
  • Meal timing, portions and swaps using foods you already eat.
  • Movement that fits your schedule.
  • A sleep and stress routine you can actually follow.

We stay with you until it sticks.

  • Regular check-ins to review progress and solve problems.
  • New habits added as the first ones become automatic.
  • Plans adjusted for festivals, travel and busy weeks.
  • Body composition retests to track real change.

Results

What Changes, and When

Lifestyle change is gradual, but you'll feel it before you see it.

  1. Weeks 1–2

    Feel better

    Better sleep, steadier energy and fewer cravings.

  2. Weeks 3–6

    Habits settle

    New routines feel easier, and clothes start to fit differently.

  3. Weeks 8–12

    See the change

    Steady fat loss, better body composition and improving health numbers.

  4. 3 months +

    A new normal

    Habits feel automatic, so results are easier to keep.

Illustrative model images. Results vary from person to person.

Myths vs facts

Lifestyle Myths, Busted

"You have to give up rice to lose weight."
Portion size and what you eat with your rice matter more than cutting it out completely.
"Skipping meals helps you lose weight."
Skipping meals usually leads to overeating later. Regular meals keep hunger and cravings steady.
"You need an hour at the gym every day."
Daily walking and a few short strength sessions a week are enough to make a real difference.
"Sleep has nothing to do with weight."
Poor sleep raises hunger hormones and cravings. It's one of the biggest hidden causes of weight gain.
"It's all about willpower."
Habits and environment matter far more. Make the healthy choice the easy choice.

Is it right for you?

Who Lifestyle Coaching Helps

  • People who've tried many diets without lasting results
  • Anyone with PCOS, thyroid problems, prediabetes or diabetes
  • People with high blood pressure, cholesterol or fatty liver
  • Busy professionals, students and parents
  • Shift workers and people with irregular routines
  • Anyone wanting more energy, better sleep and less stress

Works well with

  • Nutrition counselling
  • Medical weight management
  • Body composition analysis

Why Facelit

Why Choose Facelit for Lifestyle Coaching?

  1. 01

    Part of a medical team

    Your coach works alongside our doctors and nutrition specialists, so health conditions are taken into account.

  2. 02

    Made for Kerala life

    Plans built around Kerala food, family life, festivals, heat and monsoon.

  3. 03

    Progress you can measure

    Body composition tests show real changes in fat and muscle, not just weight.

  4. 04

    No judgement

    Honest, friendly support, whatever your starting point.

  5. 05

    Small steps, real results

    We focus on a few habits at a time, so change feels doable.

Questions

Lifestyle Coaching FAQs

What is lifestyle coaching?
Lifestyle coaching helps you change the daily habits behind your weight and health: sleep, movement, eating patterns, stress and routine. Your coach works with you over time to build small, realistic changes that last.
How is lifestyle coaching different from a diet plan?
A diet plan tells you what to eat. Lifestyle coaching looks at why, when and how you eat, plus sleep, stress and activity. It focuses on habits you can keep, not short-term rules.
Who is lifestyle coaching for?
Anyone who wants to lose weight, manage PCOS, thyroid or diabetes, sleep better, have more energy or simply build healthier habits, especially if past diets haven't lasted.
Do I need to join a gym?
No. We start with movement that fits your day, like walking, stairs and simple home exercises. If you enjoy the gym, we'll include it.
Will I have to give up rice and Kerala food?
No. We work with the food you love, adjusting portions and balance so you can enjoy your meals and still reach your goals.
How long does lifestyle coaching take?
Most people see real habit changes within 8 to 12 weeks. Lasting change takes a few months, and we're with you throughout.
How often will I meet my coach?
After your first assessment, you'll have regular follow-ups. How often depends on your plan and needs. Your coach will agree a schedule with you.
Can lifestyle coaching help with PCOS or diabetes?
Yes. Sleep, activity, stress and eating habits strongly affect PCOS, blood sugar and insulin resistance. Coaching works alongside your medical treatment.
Does it help with stress and emotional eating?
Yes. We help you notice your triggers and find other ways to cope, so food isn't your only comfort.
Will I lose weight with lifestyle coaching alone?
Many people do, especially when the main problems are habits. If you need more support, we combine coaching with nutrition counselling or medical weight management.
Can I do it if I work shifts?
Yes. We build your plan around your shifts, with meal timing, sleep and movement that fit your schedule.
Where can I get lifestyle coaching in Kerala?
Facelit offers lifestyle coaching as part of our weight management services at our clinics in Trivandrum, Karunagappally (Kollam) and Guruvayur (Thrissur).
